subject.title: feat(mobile): rename, delete, and create session groups on iOS and Android

question: Should first-party iOS and Android ship web-parity session group management now, after the iOS partial-refresh bug and real-behavior proof gap are fixed?
rationale: This is a protected maintainer-labeled feature PR that adds mobile UX and persistent client-side group state; automation can point out defects but should not decide the product scope.

options.title: Ship mobile parity after fixes
options.body: Fix the iOS partial-failure refresh path, add real mobile proof, and then continue normal maintainer review toward landing.

options.title: Narrow the mobile scope
options.body: Ask the PR to reduce scope to one platform or fewer group actions while keeping the linked issue as the parity tracker.

options.title: Keep management web-only for now
options.body: Close or defer this PR and the linked issue with a clear product decision that mobile grouping stays write-once for now.

recommendation.title: Ship mobile parity after fixes
recommendation.body: Fix the iOS partial-failure refresh path, add real mobile proof, and then continue normal maintainer review toward landing.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent mobile baseline, web reference, and current parity implementation history.
